title: Choose the Storyline workspace composition
question: All three use the approved light Approach Plate visual system. Choose the reading model that best supports a developer building a mental model of an unfamiliar codebase.

options.label: Vertical route
options.thesis: The full product path is read from top to bottom, with expansion attached exactly where it happens.
options.viewport: A left story index, a dominant vertical path, and a calm right evidence plate.
options.risk: Long paths demand careful grouping to retain the overview.

options.label: Horizontal route
options.thesis: The product path is scanned across the workspace while the selected behavior earns the page below.
options.viewport: A top flight-plan band, a broad horizontal story path, and a large focused plate beneath.
options.risk: Wide flows can make small steps feel compressed.

options.label: Dossier route
options.thesis: The current behavior leads, while a continuous route beneath it keeps the broader story legible.
options.viewport: A large behavior explanation, a quiet source margin, and a route that continues through the page.
options.risk: The selected node could dominate before a reader sees the whole path.
